rows.commentary: 6.1: Naman Dhir loops it up on the leg-stump line, and Glenn Phillips steps forward to punch it down to long-on for a single.
6.2: Naman Dhir floats one well wide of off, allowing Bevon Jacobs to stretch forward and drive it firmly to long-off for a brace.
6.3: Naman Dhir tosses it up on the leg-stump line, and Jacobs steps back to nudge it past square leg for a single.
6.4: Naman Dhir fires it flatter at the stumps, prompting Phillips to rock back and pull it past square leg for one.
6.5: Naman Dhir darts one quicker down leg, catching Jacobs as he swivels across on the pull to find short fine leg.
6.6: Naman Dhir keeps it flatter at the stumps, and Jacobs rocks back to pull it through the gap wide of mid-wicket for two runs.
7.1: Axar Patel delivers a flighted ball on the leg-stump line, tucked past square leg by Phillips for a single.
7.2: Axar Patel pushes it through outside off, where Jacobs plays a one-handed drive past cover to rotate the strike.
7.3: Axar Patel tosses it up on middle and leg, worked smoothly into the gap wide of mid-wicket by Phillips for one.
7.4: Axar Patel drops it a fraction short around off, met with a back-foot punch from Jacobs straight to cover.
7.5: Axar Patel flights this one on off, and Jacobs eases it down the ground to long-off for a single.
7.6: Axar Patel hurries one through just outside off, drawing a thick edge from Phillips to short third before a frantic dive saves him from Prince Yadav's wayward throw.
8.1: Nitish Reddy nails the yorker on middle and leg, forcing Bevon Jacobs to hurriedly jam his bat down and squeeze the ball straight back to the bowler.
8.2: Nitish Reddy digs it back of a length outside off, allowing Bevon Jacobs to step up on his toes and punch it cleanly past cover for a single.
8.3: Nitish Reddy delivers a fuller length on off, and Glenn Phillips inside-halves his drive through mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
8.4: Nitish Reddy misses his yorker by a fraction into a half-volley, and Bevon Jacobs drills it hard past the bowler with mid-off stranded.
17.6: Arshdeep Singh goes wide of off stump, drawing a mistimed drive from Glenn Phillips straight to Naman Dhir at deep point to end a fine 70-run knock.
18.1: Nitish Reddy drops it back of a length, and Bevon Jacobs stands tall to launch it downtown for an 84-metre maximum.
18.2: Nitish Reddy introduces a clever slower ball as Bevon Jacobs backs away and flashes past the inside edge.
18.3: Nitish Reddy pitches full on the stumps, and Bevon Jacobs drills it toward long-on where a fumble allows a second run.
18.4: Nitish Reddy fires in a sharp 125kph yorker that Bevon Jacobs jams near his feet, stifled by the bowler's rapid recovery.
18.5: Nitish Reddy strikes as a tempting full toss undoes Bevon Jacobs, who miscues his loft straight into the breadbasket of Axar Patel at long-off to depart for a well-made 58.
18.6: Michael Bracewell greets Nitish Reddy's full delivery with a majestic, Yuvraj-esque whip that sails effortlessly over deep square leg for a maximum.
19.1: Prince Yadav starts the over with venom, locking a pinpoint yorker onto middle and leg that Mitchell Santner can only jam anxiously back to the bowler.
19.2: Mitchell Santner digs out another yorker from Prince Yadav toward the mid-wicket pocket, hustling hard to scamper back for a sharp two runs.
19.3: Prince Yadav deploys a clever slower delivery, zipping a short ball past Mitchell Santner's under edge as the batsman's heave finds only thin air.
19.4: Mitchell Santner reads the slower bumper from Prince Yadav and pulls it firmly to the right of deep square leg to pick up another brace.
19.5: Prince Yadav's searing 132kph delivery beats Mitchell Santner's slog, pinging the front pad and allowing a scampered leg bye into the leg-side.
19.6: Michael Bracewell reads the slower back-of-a-length ball from Prince Yadav, shuffling across to scoop it deftly over the keeper's head and slam the boundary shutters down on the innings.
7.2: Bracewell tosses up an eighty-nine kph length delivery outside off, which Iyer reads from the crease and punches securely down to long-off for one.
7.3: Bowling from round the wicket, Bracewell shortens his length smartly as Abhishek steps out for an inside-out drive, instead squeezing a thick inside edge down to long-on off the arm-ball.
7.4: Iyer simply nudges Bracewell's delivery down towards the direction of long-on to rotate the strike.
7.5: Abhishek rocks back against an eighty-seven kph delivery around the top of off from Bracewell, punching it cleanly through point for a run.
7.6: Bracewell targets the stumps with a turning ball, forcing Iyer onto the back foot to punch sharply to the left of short midwicket where the fielder smartly intercepts.
8.1: Santner drifts a ninety kph length delivery onto the pads, allowing Abhishek to tickle it smoothly through the leg side.
8.2: Santner floats one in at eighty-nine kph targeting the stumps, and a retreating Iyer creates room to punch it low and just short of the bowler's outstretched hand.
8.3: Santner smartly trails the advancing Iyer who tries to force an inside-out shot over extra cover, inducing a thick inside edge off the holding surface down to long-on.
8.4: Mitchell Santner out-smarts Abhishek Sharma, who clears his front leg only to miscue his slog against the wind into the waiting hands of Nathan Smith at deep midwicket.
8.5: Mitchell Santner keeps it tight as Axar Patel stays back on the crease, punching the back-of-a-length delivery sharply into the cover region.
8.6: Mitchell Santner slides one into the pads, and Axar Patel's flick is expertly intercepted by the midwicket fielder to prevent the single.
9.1: Michael Bracewell delivers a flat, spinning ball on middle and leg, comfortably worked away by Shreyas Iyer down to long-on for a single.
9.2: Michael Bracewell darts one in from round the wicket, cramping Axar Patel for room as he plays a defensive push back toward the bowler.
9.3: Michael Bracewell hangs it up there at eighty-one kph wide of off, tempting Axar Patel down to sweep before the batter miscues horribly over the bowler for a single.
9.4: Shreyas Iyer takes a single off Michael Bracewell.
17.2: Jacob Duffy bangs it short to Nitish Reddy, who can only manage a grimace and a single pulled to deep midwicket.
17.3: Jacob Duffy darts a slower ball wide, allowing Tilak Varma to step across and pull it past long-on for four as the crowd erupts.
17.4: Jacob Duffy tries the wide yorker but overcooks it completely, sending the ball so far outside off that Tilak Varma easily lets it pass.
17.4: Jacob Duffy locks onto the tramline with a surgical wide yorker that leaves Tilak Varma swinging through thin air into absolute emptiness.
17.5: Jacob Duffy serves up a full toss outside off that Tilak Varma dispatches wide of mid-off, rendering Santner's diving effort futile.
17.6: Jacob Duffy drops it short and slow outside off, catching Tilak Varma out with a scorching pull straight to deep midwicket on the bounce.
18.1: Nathan Smith delivers a full ball on middle and off where Tilak Varma attempts a scoop, skewing a thick edge over short third for four.
18.2: Nathan Smith fires in a slower short ball that Tilak Varma fiercely pulls to deep midwicket, where Phillips misjudges the dive and lets it through.
18.3: Nathan Smith sneaks a wide slower bouncer past Tilak Varma, who reaches out to cut and finds only thin air.
18.4: Nathan Smith digs it in short, leaving Tilak Varma to swivel across and pull it behind square into the vacant deep grass for four.
18.5: Nathan Smith fires in a sharp yorker just outside off, beating a charging Tilak Varma all ends up.
18.6: Nathan Smith offers a slower length ball wide outside off, which Tilak Varma coolly reaches back and hoists over wide long-off for a magnificent six.
19.1: Jacob Duffy digs it in short, finding Nitish Reddy who pulls hard into the turf straight to deep midwicket on the bounce for a single.
19.2: Jacob Duffy misses his mark with a full and wide delivery, allowing Tilak Varma to absolutely blast it through extra cover for a boundary.
19.3: Jacob Duffy attacks with a short ball outside off that rushes Tilak Varma into a mistimed pull toward long-on, scrambling back with a desperate dive to complete two runs and bring up his fifty.
19.4: Jacob Duffy goes short outside off again, eliciting an aerial cut that lands safely short of sweeper cover for a single.
19.5: Jacob Duffy beats the ramp shot with sheer pace on another bumper, but the umpire stretches his arms wide for height.
19.5: Jacob Duffy drops a full toss onto the pads of Nitish Reddy, who flicks it neatly into the gap for two runs to seal a remarkable series victory in Christchurch for India.
